         <milestone unit="section" n="223.231.112 de dag mtshan nyid du ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul"/>
         gnyis pa de dag mtshan nyid du ji ltar 'gyur ba <lb n="26a2"/> 'i tshul ni |
         <mentioned>'dir gnyi' ga mngon sum gyi rigs mi mthun sel pa'i mtshan nyid du dgos pa 'am | 'on te gang yang rung pas chog ce na | </mentioned>
       'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">gzhan dag</rs><note type="editorial">This view is attributed to (rNgog) Lo tså ba (ID:3786) and Dul ba lha (Vinîtadeva)(ID:5534) in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 182,23-24.</note> gnyi' ga rigs mi mthun sel pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod mod  kyi de dag gis ma 'khrul pa'i don ma shes pas 'khrul pa yin te | yang dgag pa'i 'bad pa bya mi dgos so || des na mngon sum gyi rigs mi mthun sel pa'i mtshan nyid ni gzung don la ma 'khrul pa nyid yin te | <lb n="26a3"/> bzlog phyogs mngon sum ltar snang mtha' dag de nyid kyis bcad pa'i phyir ro || 'on kyang rtog bral mtshan nyid du smos pa ni ¦ rigs pa can lasogs pa dag mngon sum yul nye ba nges pa rtog{} pa yin no zhes zer ba'i log rtogs bzlog pa'i phyir khyab byed la mtshan nyid kyi ming gis btags nas gsungs pa yin par gdon mi za'o ||§||</seg></TEI>
